rejected.prompt: Edit this existing sprite atlas to FIX ITS GRID LAYOUT. Preserve all sixteen fantasy units, their style, factions and exact order. Output one square transparent RGBA canvas. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of perfectly equal square cells. CRITICAL: scale each COMPLETE unit down to fit inside only the CENTRAL 72% of its cell. Each cell must have a very generous transparent EMPTY margin of at least 14% on all four sides. No heads, feet, weapons, horns or capes within these margins. Each cell centered precisely at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% canvas width and the same percentages of height. All four row baselines identical relative to their cell. Do not arrange rows organically. Game engine will cut the image at EXACTLY 25%, 50%, 75% of width and height, so no part of a unit may cross those cuts. Keep original painted dark fantasy art. No added labels or grid lines. Original human top two rows and demon bottom two rows unchanged order. Transparent background; no black pixels except actual character outlines.
